name: When should I consider installing a fold-down shower seat?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider installing a fold-down shower seat?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider installing a fold-down shower seat if anyone in your household has mobility limitations, experiences fatigue while standing for extended periods, or is at risk of falls. This includes seniors, individuals recovering from surgery or injury, or those with chronic conditions. It's also a practical addition for future-proofing your bathroom, enhancing accessibility, and increasing the overall safety and comfort for all users. Even in a small shower, its space-saving design makes it a versatile solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider installing a fold-down shower seat if you or a family member has mobility issues, experiences fatigue, or is at risk of falls. It's also good for future-proofing your bathroom's accessibility.
